## Approved outcome

Link the approved roadmap outcome or product decision and describe the concrete user scenario. For a repair or proportionate usability change, identify the existing outcome it preserves.

## Placement and scope

Explain why Kora owns this behavior rather than a tool, MCP service or skill. State exclusions and any retired scope affected. Available dependencies, passing tests and free implementation capacity are not product approval.

## User-visible behavior

Describe the operation completed through the applicable voice, typed, native and model routes. Label navigation/preparation honestly. Preserve required confirmation, privacy and authentication exceptions; do not claim field preparation completes the request.

## Validation and compatibility

Link exact-source validation evidence and disclose failures or unrun checks. Describe retained-data/schema/audit compatibility, cancellation and unavailable behavior where affected. Keep product admission distinct from implementation, enablement and RC qualification.
